article.title: Emergent Ventures Covid-19 prizes, second cohort
article.excerpt: There is another round of prize winners, and I am pleased and honored to announce them: 1. Petr Ludwig . Petr has been instrumental in building out the #Masks4All movement, and in persuading individuals in the Czech Republic, and in turn the world, to wear masks.
